card.line: The Valley of Gerar is a valley where Isaac settled after leaving Abimelech, reopened his father's wells, and found room to thrive.

moments.title: Isaac settles in the valley
moments.text: Abimelech told Isaac to leave because he was too powerful. Isaac left and camped in the Valley of Gerar and settled there.

moments.title: Old wells reopened
moments.text: Isaac reopened the wells his father Abraham had dug, which the Philistines had stopped up. He gave them the same names Abraham had given.

moments.title: Quarrels over wells
moments.text: Isaac's servants found a well of fresh water, but the herdsmen of Gerar said the water was theirs. Isaac named the wells Esek and Sitnah because of the quarrels.

moments.title: Room at last
moments.text: Isaac moved on and dug another well, and no one quarreled over it. He named it Rehoboth and said the LORD had made room for them to be fruitful.
